text_block_list.name: Cesario
choice_data_list: Good morning. Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The weather was so nice yesterday
that Craft and I aired out our futons, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The futon got super fluffy!
Craft and I couldn't help but dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Take a nap right after diving in, and sleep soundly through the night in a futon that still smells like the sun...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "My body feels so light, it's been ages since I had such a refreshing morning! Heheh♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I slept so much, I'm brimming with energy.
It seems I had a great rest, like basking in the sun.
